in-012.because: Everyone sent me warm rooms and kind women, and I'd have taken any of them, but only one answered the question I was actually too embarrassed to ask out loud, which is who pays — a levy on the employers per night-shift worker, not per child, so the people running the machines round the clock are the people funding the cots. And they were right that goodwill is just a wage somebody in this town has quietly not been getting for years.
